$comment: Never add a connection string, key, token or password to this file. Secrets come from
dotnet user-secrets (local) or environment variables / the secret store (deployed).
See README.md, 'Configuration and secrets', and appsettings.Development.template.json.

Database.$comment: ConnectionString is deliberately absent — it is a secret. Startup fails without it.

Authentication.$comment: Placeholder authenticates nobody. Startup REFUSES this mode outside Development.

Cors.$comment: Exact origins only. Wildcards are rejected by CorsOptionsValidator.

Observability.$comment: Empty OtlpEndpoint disables export and logs to console only.
